description: connect GitHub, find and add repositories and integrations. The server runs in workspace mode. Project {{NAME}} exists. Call "changes-match" says "ok" if the account changes the editor asked for are as expected (otherwise it returns them); call "repos" returns the saved repositories of {{NAME}}. "The editor" is {"role": "region", "name": "Edit project", "exact": true}, the element section[aria-label='Edit project']; things "in the editor" are scoped to it (a selector after "section[aria-label='Edit project'] ", or {"within": {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project']"}, ...} for a role). Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. "The search" is {"within": {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project']"}, "role": "searchbox", "name": "Search repositories"} (an input type=search with that aria-label); "the owner" is {"within": {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project']"}, "role": "combobox", "name": "Owner"} (a select). "The connect link" is {"within": {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project']"}, "role": "link", "name": "Connect GitHub"}. "The clickhouse integration" is {"selector": "section[aria-label='Edit project'] [data-testid='project-integrations'] .project-repo-row", "has_text": "clickhouse"}. 1. Navigate to /. 2.
